separation_rule: One principal may hold multiple roles, but every role retains its own scope, decision record, evidence requirements, and claim ceiling. Architecture, context meaning, local language, relationship mapping, capability instances, migration intent, lineage evidence, source admission, semantic promotion, and conformance remain independent authorities; no field or role is silently inferred from another.
